tuning_claim: Finite local candidate comparison only; no claim of global or fully tuned optimum
origin_semantics: Raw EV NED observation has [world_y, world_x, -world_z]; with zero EV/IMU offsets, no GNSS position fusion resets EKF local XY to [world_y, world_x]. EV height reference resets global altitude to world_z, retaining an existing origin altitude: local_z=ref_alt-world_z. Require live frame bridge checks; old GPS/world geodetic mapping is not a valid precision-mode target conversion.
transport: Existing owned VehicleAPI.link only; raw-byte PX4 PARAM_SET / PARAM_VALUE

restore_storage_save.semantics: Pinned param.cpp save without path calls do_save_default -> param_save_default(true); exit 0 means synchronous success
